subject: Grabbing input values using variable names

messages.author: c772b73344255d92
messages.subject: Grabbing input values using variable names
parts:
I have several numericInput boxes with id="num_input1","num_input2","num_input3", etc...
On the server.R side is it possible to access these dynamically, i.e.
foo <- "num_input2"
#tried all these
output$foo_testing <- renderText(input$foo)
#
output$foo_testing <- renderText(paste("input$",foo,sep=""))
#
output$foo_testing <- renderText(get(paste("input$",foo,sep="")))
#
output$foo_testing <- renderText(input[[foo]])
Please let me know if my question is explained well enough, if not I can provide a full set of example codes.

Thanks for the help,
Morgan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Grabbing input values using variable names
parts: Yes, input[[foo]] should work, as should `$`(input, foo).
